title: 3 Men Vanished From This Lighthouse — The Log Book Made It Worse
title_ab: The Lighthouse Where 3 Keepers Vanished Without a Trace
description:
In December 1900, three experienced lighthouse keepers vanished from a remote Scottish island. The lamp was clean. The beds were made. One meal sat unfinished on the table.

What the relief crew found in the log book has never been explained. Two sets of oilskins were gone — but the third pair still hung by the door. And the only door that mattered was locked from the inside.

This is the full story of the Flannan Isles, and the one detail almost every retelling gets wrong.
